mana_flows.description: Cross-domain connections are not arbitrary. They follow elemental transmutation rules:
rules: MYTHOS (Water) → ETHOS (Fire): Stories teach morality. Flood myths encode stewardship ethics.
ETHOS (Fire) → PHYSICAL (Earth): Moral imperative drives engineering. Build to survive.
PHYSICAL (Earth) → METAPHYSICAL (Air): Matter studied deeply reveals hidden structure. Branching ratios mirror cosmic design.
METAPHYSICAL (Air) → MYTHOS (Water): Hidden patterns generate new symbols. Numbers become omens. Topology becomes legend.

METAPHYSICAL (Air) → ETHOS (Fire): Consciousness of hidden truth demands ethical action. Knowing the Riemann Hypothesis is true changes nothing physically, but changes everything morally about the nature of order.
PHYSICAL (Earth) → MYTHOS (Water): Physical anomalies (earth lights, dimuon excess) generate folklore. The event precedes the story.
MYTHOS (Water) → PHYSICAL (Earth): Folklore predicts physical sites. Legends mark quartz deposits.
ETHOS (Fire) → METAPHYSICAL (Air): The will to do good opens perception. Service to others is a sensory modality.
